description_en: You can invoke ModifyUserLevelsOfSkillGroup to modify the skill levels of one or more agents under a specified skill group in a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ModifyUserLevelsOfSkillGroup修改指定实例下指定技能组下属的一个或多个坐席的技能等级
kebab_example: aliyun ccc modify-user-levels-of-skill-group --instance-id ccc-test --skill-group-id skillgroup@ccc-test --user-level-list userId_:_agent1@ccc-test_,_skillLevel_:1_,_userId_:_agent2@ccc-test_,_skillLevel_:10 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyUserLevelsOfSkillGroup

parameters.help_en: A JSON-formatted string representing an array of agent skill levels. Each array element is an object containing two fields: userId and skillLevel. Specify the agent ID in userId and the desired skill level in skillLevel. The skill level must be an integer from 1 to 10, where a lower value indicates stronger business capability and the ability to handle more calls per unit time
parameters.help_zh: 坐席技能等级列表，格式为JSON数组的字符串，数组元素是一个对象，包含两个字段：userId和skillLevel，userId填写想要修改的坐席ID，skillLevel填写想要修改的技能等级，取值范围1-10，值越小，业务能力越强，单位时间内能处理更多的通话
parameters.name: user_level_list
